rationale: The agent verified identity using full name and zip, matched to a single user, before accessing orders. It confirmed the exact action before any write. When item removal failed due to tool constraints, the agent correctly explained the limitation and sought confirmation to cancel the entire order. Upon explicit confirmation with a stated reason, it canceled the pending order via the tool; the tool shows status changed to cancelled and a full refund transaction. The agent then provided grill prices from a prior order accurately based on tool data. No unauthorized actions occurred, and no writes were performed without confirmation. Minor nitpicks: the initial suggestion that it could remove the item (before discovering the tool limitation) and the generic 5–7 business day refund timeline (not explicitly supported by tools) do not materially affect correctness or policy compliance.
